Definition: Jerachmeel, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jerahmeel = "may God have pity"; 1) the 1st son of Hezron, grandson of Pharez, and great grandson of Judah and the founder of the family of Jerahmeelites; 2) officer sent by king Jehoiakim of Judah to arrest Baruch; 3) a Merarite Levite the representative of the family of Kish, the son of Mahli
